title: 第1135章 以往的回忆第1134章 望前辈怜惜
slug: 合欢宗从照顾师弟道侣开始修仙
content_zh:
美妇紧咬牙关。
那双美眸中满是恨意。
只不过死了一个剑侍而已。
这等小恩怨竟然就灭了朱家满门。
就在这时，美妇感觉到了一道目光看向了自己。
美妇娇躯一颤。
眼中的恨意一扫而空。
转身扑通一声伏跪在地。
那丰满的腰臀高高的躬着。
勾画出了诱人的曲线。
“朱家之恶，罄竹难书，妾身知道朱家迟早会有这么一天，没有前辈，也会有其他人，妾身只是一个弱女子，无法承担也不想承担朱家灭门之仇，还望前辈怜惜，饶妾身一命，前辈留着朱家人的性命想必有着大用处，妾身身为朱家主母愿为前辈驱使。为奴为婢也心甘情愿。”
美妇的声音中带着一丝颤音。
声音中充满了决绝与哀求。
李蒙饶有兴趣的看着伏跪在地的美妇。
这位朱家主母真会演戏。
瞧这柔弱哀求的样子真是让人心疼。
没有哪个男人会拒绝吧。
李蒙自然也不会拒绝。
不就是演戏嘛。
只要这位朱家主母能够一直演下去。

他也不是不能接受。
李蒙打了一个哈欠朝着内室走去。
“有什么事情明日再说吧。”
伏跪在地的美妇脸色一喜。
她连忙起身站了起来。
微微低着头恭敬的跟在了李蒙身后。
跟着李蒙进入了内室。
李蒙爬上了床榻。
刚在床榻边坐下。
美妇连忙向前蹲在地上。
伸出纤纤玉手抓住了李蒙的脚。
为李蒙脱起了鞋子。
李蒙倒也没有拒绝。
眯着眼看着大献殷勤的美妇。
“你叫什么名字？”
美妇抬头朝着李蒙展颜一笑。
只是笑容有些勉强。
“妾身姓朱，明怀英，妾身并非朱家之人，年幼时被师尊收养，师尊是朱家长老，便带着妾身回到了朱家，妾身出身于贫苦凡人之家，一场旱灾让妾身家破人亡，幸得遇到师尊才改变了命运，那时候的妾身就是一个假小子，留着一头短发，身上穿的还是男孩子的衣服，师尊遇到妾身时还以为妾身是个男孩，便取名为“怀英”。”
content_en:
The beautiful woman gritted her teeth.
Those beautiful eyes were full of hatred.
It's just that a swordsman died.
This small grudge actually wiped out the entire Zhu family.
At this moment, the beautiful woman felt a gaze looking at her.
The beautiful woman's delicate body trembled.
The hatred in his eyes disappeared.
He turned around and fell to his knees with a plop.
The plump waist and hips were bowed high.
Drawing out alluring curves.
"The evils of the Zhu family are too numerous to describe. I know that the Zhu family will have such a day sooner or later. If there is no senior, there will be others. I am just a weak woman. I cannot bear and do not want to bear the revenge of the Zhu family's destruction. I hope that the senior will take pity on me and spare my life. The life of the Zhu family must be of great use. As the mistress of the Zhu family, I am willing to be driven by senior. I am also willing to be a slave and maid."
There was a hint of vibrato in the beautiful woman's voice.
The voice was full of determination and pleading.
Li Meng looked at the beautiful woman kneeling on the ground with interest.
This mistress of the Zhu family really knows how to act.
It's really heartbreaking to see this weak and pleading look.
No man would say no.
Naturally, Li Meng would not refuse.
Isn't it just acting?
As long as the Zhu family's mistress can continue to act.
It's not that he can't accept it.
Li Meng yawned and walked towards the inner room.
"Let's talk about anything tomorrow."
The beautiful woman who was kneeling on the ground looked happy.
She quickly stood up.
He lowered his head slightly and followed Li Meng respectfully.
He followed Li Meng into the inner room.
Li Meng climbed onto the bed.
Just sat down by the bed.
The beautiful woman quickly squatted forward and squatted on the ground.
He stretched out his delicate hands and grabbed Li Meng's feet.
He took off his shoes for Li Meng.
Li Meng did not refuse.
He squinted his eyes and looked at the attentive beautiful woman.
"What's your name?"
The beautiful woman raised her head and smiled at Li Meng.
It's just that the smile is a little forced.
"My surname is Zhu, Ming Huaiying. I am not from the Zhu family. I was adopted by my master when I was young. The master is the elder of the Zhu family, so he took me back to the Zhu family. I was born in a poor mortal family. A drought destroyed my family. Fortunately, my family was ruined. It was only when I met Master that my fate changed. At that time, I was a tomboy with short hair and wearing boy's clothes. When Master met me, I thought I was a boy, so I named her "Huaiying."
